issue_context.title: remove useless transaction isolation setup
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
The setup of transaction isolation is useless in auto analyze.

review_comments:
Since it is set below at line 431/430 like this:
`terror.Log(sctx.GetSessionVars().SetSystemVar(variable.TxnIsolation, ast.ReadCommitted))`
Should it not be restored upon return?
Or should InRestrictedSSQL always run in ReadCommitted?

Sorry, I missed it. Actually the previous `analyze` should have used https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/619c4720059ea619081b01644ef3084b426d282f/kv/kv.go#L449, which is not the same as isolation level = 'READ-COMMITTED'. So, I think that the isolation setting here should be meaningless. However, I will confirm this further.
